idea: His elbow skids off the bar edge, he lurches sideways and grabs the bar again just in time, grinning.
motion:
The camera does not move. The grey-haired man on the green stool, leaning to frame right with his forearm on the bar and his pint in his other hand, sways further right. Within the first second his elbow skids off the polished bar edge and he lurches sideways, pint wobbling but not spilling. His hand slaps back onto the bar and he catches himself, then gives a proud, sleepy grin and settles, swaying gently. Quiet pub murmur, a soft slap of palm on wood. No speech. The camera does not move.
Thanks.

idea: He lifts the pint to drink, misses his mouth and bumps the glass into his cheek, foam on his nose.
motion:
The camera does not move. The grey-haired man on the green stool, leaning on the bar to frame right, lifts his pint toward his mouth in one quick, wobbly swing. He misses: the rim bumps his cheek beside his mouth and a dab of foam lands on his nose. He blinks at the glass, puzzled, then lowers it and settles, leaning on the bar, foam still on his nose. Quiet pub murmur, a tiny clink of glass on stubble. No speech. The camera does not move.
Thanks.

idea: His arm slides off the bar and he slumps the last bit down onto the floorboards, still smiling.
motion:
The camera does not move. The grey-haired man half-sitting on the floorboards, one arm hooked over the bar edge beside his pint, legs splayed toward the lower left, starts to slip. Within the first second his arm slides off the bar and he sinks the last bit down, landing flat on his back on the wooden floor with a soft thud. The pint stays on the bar. He lies there, still smiling contentedly up at the ceiling, and does not move again. Quiet pub murmur. No speech. The camera does not move.
Thanks.

idea: He hauls himself up by the bar, rises a few inches, and slides straight back down to the floor.
motion:
The camera does not move. The grey-haired man slumped on the floorboards, one arm over the bar edge beside his pint, legs splayed, grips the bar and heaves. His body rises a few inches, legs scrabbling on the boards, then his grip gives and he slides straight back down to where he started with a bump, still smiling. The pint stays on the bar. He settles, arm still hooked over the bar, and nods to himself. Quiet pub murmur, a thud on the boards. No speech. The camera does not move.
Thanks.

idea: The stool tips all the way and he lands flat on his back on the floorboards, stool clattering beside him.
motion:
The camera does not move. The grey-haired man tipping backwards on the green stool, arms flung up, pint in his raised hand, keeps falling. In the first second the stool tips over and he drops flat onto his back on the wooden floorboards, legs up then down, while the stool clatters and rolls beside him and the beer splashes onto the boards. He lies still, arms spread, the empty glass unbroken in his hand, blinking at the ceiling. Quiet pub murmur, a thud and a wooden clatter. No speech. The camera does not move.
Thanks.

idea: He crashes to the floor, but the airborne beer falls neatly back into the pint he holds up, not a drop lost.
motion:
The camera does not move. The grey-haired man tipping backwards on the green stool, arms flung up, pint held high with beer arcing out of it, falls. In the first second he lands on his back on the floorboards, the stool clattering over beside him, but his raised hand stays perfectly steady: the arc of beer falls back into the glass, which ends upright and full above him. He looks up at it, delighted. Quiet pub murmur, a thud and a wooden clatter. No speech. The camera does not move.
Thanks.
